agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Chooses which accounts to investigate and the hypotheses to test

agents.name: Investigator
agents.role: Writes churn-risk claims, each citing a Zetaris fact

agents.name: Verifier
agents.role: Rejects claims the data does not support, sends drafts back when a signal is missed, checks the Skeptic's rulings

agents.name: Skeptic
agents.role: Argues against every claim and looks for innocent explanations

agents.name: Escalation
agents.role: Escalates high-risk, high-revenue or near-renewal accounts

agents.name: Reporter
agents.role: Writes the brief, the recommended play and a draft email

agents.name: Memory
agents.role: Recalls earlier weeks per account, stores this week's verdict, rewards helpful memories

notes: 8 step(s) used the offline heuristic instead of a model
